ana: Following the INC-2026-03-18 postmortem — quick sync to lock owners and near-term checkpoints for GPU capacity/autoscale work. Please ack and flag blockers.

ana: ACTIONS (short):
- quota emergency + long-term plan (owner: raj, ETA: 2026-03-24)
- headroom policy + sim runs (owner: sylvia, ETA: 2026-04-02)
- scheduler tweak: lower preempt window, refine binpack scoring (owner: ben, ETA: 2026-03-22)
- autoscale harness: replay spike + validate step-scaling (owner: ana, ETA: 2026-03-29)
- runbook updates: surge triage + region constraints (owner: ana, ETA: 2026-03-21)

raj: Ack. Opening emergency quota ticket now, will paste support link and requested SKUs. Need usage curve for the long-term ask 11 data-ops?

sylvia: Ack. For headroom sims I propose starting at 15% prod headroom and 25% for p99 workloads. Will run replay across us-west/us-east and report variance. Need sanitized trace link.

ben: Ack. Plan: preempt 120s->40s, enable soft-affinity binpack. Canary config will emit p50/p95 token latency and preemption_count. Rollback if p95 grows >5%.

ana: ops-bot, pls schedule weekly follow-up.

ops-bot: Reminder set: "GPU capacity follow-ups" starting 2026-03-23 09:00 PT (recurrence: weekly). Assigned to: ana, raj, ben.

ana: I'll add a minimal KPI sheet (p50/p95, preemptions, scale latency, cost delta) and post link in the postmortem doc by EOD. If any ETA slips >48h, escalate to eng-sre lead.

raj: Ticket created: https://cloud.vendor/support/Q-7722. Posting provider contacts in that ticket.

sylvia: Uploaded trace to postmortems: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/INC-2026-03-18/trace-sample. Using fields: ts, req_type, tokens.

ana: Thanks all, owners acked. I'll send calendar invites and update the incident tracker. :white_check_mark:
